rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He reads “after the Reminder” either as after the Torah or after earlier notices on this subject.
rows.anchor: Tevrat’tan sonra Zebur’da, yahut bu babda bazı ihtârâttan sonra Zebur’da yazdık

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God takes the earth from corrupters and gives it to rightful servants fit to inherit it and exercise stewardship.
rows.anchor: Arz ifsad edenlerden alınır, verâsete lâyık, hilâfete ehil salâhiyetli hak kullarına verilir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The law of righteousness governs lasting survival; the corrupt have no rightful claim to endure.
rows.anchor: sırr-ı bekā, salâh kanununa müterettibdir, bozukların hakk-ı bekāsı yoktur.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The drowning of Pharaoh and despots, Israel inheriting the Holy Land, and David's defeat of Goliath practically foreshadowed this law; David's appointment as caliph is linked to 38:26.
rows.anchor: Firavun ve cebâbirenin gark ve def‘iyle onların zayıf gördükleri kulların Arz-ı Mukaddes’in şark u garbına vâris kılınması

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Under the law of the most righteous or most fitting, scriptural peoples first prevailed over others, then Jews, Christians, and Muslims successively prevailed; Muslims will continue while preserving righteousness.
rows.anchor: Aslah kanunu” yahut “elyak kanunu” denilen bu kanunun hükmüyledir ki evvelâ sûret-i umûmiyede

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After Muhammad's mission, inheritance belongs to one community of monotheistic believers who do righteous deeds, resist shirk, division, rebellion, and discord, and strive for the best works.
rows.anchor: îmân-ı tevhid ile mü’min ve a‘mâl-i sâliha ile âmil ümmet-i vâhide olarak

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After the heavens are folded and the earth changed, the righteous will inherit the earth of Paradise as well.
rows.anchor: Nihâyet gökler dürülüp Arz değiştikten sonra arz-ı cennetin verâseti de bunlarındır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Though schisms divide the Muslim community and lands are lost, a saved group following the Prophet and Companions remains, as signaled by 23:53 and sound hadith.
rows.anchor: وَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ ile işaret edildiği ve ehâdîs-i sahîhada vârid olduğu üzere

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hadith reports that religion will become strange and the righteous strangers, then religion will reappear as it first began.
rows.anchor: zamanlar gelecek din garip olacak, sâlihîn garip kalacak, sonra yine din bed’ ettiği gibi dönüp zuhur edecek

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After about thirty false claimants to prophethood, the great Dajjal will claim divinity and perish at the Messiah's descent.
rows.anchor: peygamberlik iddiasında bulunacak olan otuz kadar deccalden sonra ulûhiyet iddiasına kalkışacak olan koca Deccal, Mesih’in nüzûlüyle helâk olacak

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Gog and Magog will bring unprecedented corruption and unimaginable wars before being destroyed by God's command.
rows.anchor: Ye’cûc ve Me’cûc çıkacak, yeryüzünde görülmedik fesatlar, tasvîre sığmaz harpler yaptıktan sonra bi-emrillah mahvolacaklar

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After the cross is broken and swine killed, the righteous will rule, Muhammad's law will be universal, and humanity will enter an age of bliss.
rows.anchor: salîb kırılacak, hınzır öldürülecek, sâlihîn hâkim olacak, şer‘-i Muhammedînin ta‘mîmiyle beşeriyet bir devr-i saadete girecek

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After lesser and intermediate upheavals, the Beast, sunrise from the west, and trumpet herald the Great Resurrection; a second blast restores creation, followed by gathering, Judgment, and Paradise for the righteous.
rows.anchor: Dâbbetü’larz’ın hurûcu ve Güneş’in mağribden tulû‘u ve Sûr’un nefhiyle büyük kıyamet kopacak

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “That” sums up the preceding direction: this is the command and the way one must act.
rows.anchor: İşte öyle yani emir böyle, böyle yapılmak lâzım gelir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's sacred limits include His rulings, commands, and prohibitions, as well as places and things He has made sacred, such as the Sacred House, Mosque, town, sanctuary, and month.
rows.anchor: Allah’ın ahkâmına, emirlerine, nehiylerine ve Beyt-i Haram

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Revering these limits means recognizing the duty to honor them and acting accordingly.
rows.anchor: riayetin vücûbunu bilerek ve mûcebince amel ederek ihtiram ederse

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The worshipper will see the benefit of this reverence in the Hereafter with the Lord.
rows.anchor: Âhirette o tâzimin hayrını görür.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Livestock are lawful and are not among the sacredly prohibited; the customary categories of bahira, saiba, wasila, and ham do not change that, and all eight pairs are lawful.
rows.anchor: hurumâttan değildir. Sûre-i En‘âm’da beyan olunduğu üzere bahîre, sâibe, vasîle, hâm yok, semâniyete ezvâc hepsi helâl

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The exception is the forbidden food detailed at 5:3: carrion, blood, swine, and animals dedicated to other than God.
rows.anchor: meyte, dem, hınzır[^2], وَمَٓا اُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ اللهِّٰ’dır [5/3]

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Avoid both tangible filth such as carrion and the spiritual filth of idols; slaughter livestock in God's name and cleanse the House of idols.
rows.anchor: meyte gibi hissî ve maddî pisliklerden ictinab ile beraber nusub u asnâm gibi mânevî pisliklerden de sakınınız

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Avoid false speech: do not tell lies or promote them, and keep away from falsification.
rows.anchor: söylemediğiniz gibi tervic de etmeyiniz, tezvîrâttan uzak olunuz.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Idol worship is itself a form of falsification akin to false testimony, and indeed its chief form.
rows.anchor: evsâna tapmak da yalancı şâhidlik kabîlinden tezvîrâttır, hatta tezvîrâtın başıdır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It is false speech and belief to declare forbidden what God did not forbid, including claims that bahira, saiba, wasila, and ham are prohibited; such filth must be shunned.
rows.anchor: Allah’ın haram kılmadığı şeylere haram demekten; “bahîre, sâibe, vasîle, hâm haramdır” demek gibi yalan sözlerden ve akidelerden sakının

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Falah means attaining one's desired goal or triumph; it is also defined as abiding in goodness.
rows.anchor: “Felah”, murâda zafer bulmaktır. Hayırda bekā diye de târif edilmiştir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Iflah can mean causing someone to attain success or entering into success; the Qur'an generally uses it in the latter sense.
rows.anchor: “İflâh”, felâha nâil kılmak mânasına geldiği gibi felâha girmek, yani bizim tâbirimizle felâh bulmak mânasına da gelir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God promises certain success to people who gather seven qualities; faith is the first, discussed at length in al-Baqara.
rows.anchor: yedi sıfatı câmi‘olan kimseler için felâhın muhakkak husûlünü tebşir buyurmaktadır ki bu yedi sıfattan evvelkisi imandır

rows.speaker: bazıları
rows.claim: Some define khushu as an inward act of the heart, such as fear and awe.
rows.anchor: bazıları “havf” ve[^2]“rehbet” gibi kalb fiillerinden olmak üzere târif etmiş

rows.speaker: bazıları
rows.claim: Others define khushu through bodily acts, such as stillness and refraining from looking around.
rows.anchor: bazıları da sükûn ve terk-i iltifat gibi cevârih fiillerinden göstermiştir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı prefers a combined account: khushu originates in the heart and appears in the body.
rows.anchor: Doğrusu “huşû‘”, aslı kalbde, tezahürü bedende olmak üzere ikisini de câmi‘dir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Inwardly it is profound reverence before divine majesty, making the self submit to God's command and attend only to reverence and propriety.
rows.anchor: azamet ve celâl-i rabbânî karşısında kendi küçüklüğünü göstererek nefsi emr-i Hakk’a serfürû ettirecek ve edeb ü tâzimden başka bir hâtıraya iltifat etmeyecek

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Outwardly it produces calm limbs and gaze directed to the place of prostration, without looking to either side or at distractions.
rows.anchor: a‘zâ-yı bedende bu hissin tezahürüyle bir sükûn ve sekînet hâsıl olması ve gözlerinin önüne secde mevzi‘ine bakıp sağa sola

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The inward root of khushu relates to perfecting the intention, a condition of prayer; its outward display relates to prayer's manners and refinements.
rows.anchor: huşû‘un aslı, namazın şartlarından olan niyetin kemâliyle, tezâhürâtı da namazın âdâb ve mükemmilâtıyla alâkadardır.

rows.speaker: Hasan ve İbn Sîrîn
rows.claim: Hasan and Ibn Sirin report that the Messenger and Companions once raised their eyes skyward in prayer, then lowered them after this verse and stopped ihtisar.
rows.anchor: Hasan’dan ve İbn Sîrîn’den rivayet olunduğuna göre Resûlullah ve ashâbı namazda gözlerini semâya kaldırırlardı, bu âyetin nüzûlü üzerine önlerine eğdiler ve ıhtisârı terk ettiler.

rows.speaker: Hazret-i Aişe
rows.claim: Aisha reports in al-Bukhari and Muslim that the Prophet called looking around in prayer a snatching by Satan from the servant's prayer.
rows.anchor: Buhârî ve Müslim’de Hazret-i Aişe’den de rivayet olunur ki; “Resûlullah’a namazda iltifattan sual ettim

rows.speaker: Ümm-i Rûman
rows.claim: Umm Ruman recounts Abu Bakr rebuking her for rocking in prayer, then citing the Prophet that worshippers should be still and not rock like Jews, since still limbs complete prayer.
rows.anchor: Ümm-i Rûman radıyallahu anhâ demiştir ki: “Namazımda sallanıyordum, Ebû Bekir radıyallahu anh gördü, beni öyle bir azarladı ki az daha namazdan çıkacaktım.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The believers turn away from laghw, meaning futile speech and actions.
rows.anchor: Ve onlar ki lağvdan çekinirler beyhûde kavl ü fiilden sakınırlar

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The immediate sense of doing zakat is giving zakat from one's wealth.
rows.anchor: bundan mütebâdir olan mâna, mallarının zekâtını verirler demektir.

rows.speaker: bazıları
rows.claim: Some understand zakat here to mean refinement and purification.
rows.anchor: bazıları bu ifadeye nazaran “zekât”tan murad, tehzib ve tahâret mânası olduğunu söylemişlerdir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı says “doing the work of zakat” can include purification of the self, body, and wealth.
rows.anchor: “Zekât işini yaparlar” demek nefsî, bedenî, mâlî zekâtın hepsine de şâmil olabilir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Chastity is to be guarded except with wives or owned slave women; seeking sexual relations beyond these bounds makes one a transgressor.
rows.anchor: artık bunun ilerisini isteyen olursa {فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ} işte onlar mütecâvizdirler.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The apparent wording of the passage also indicates that temporary marriage is forbidden.
rows.anchor: Bu âyetin zâhiri müt‘anın dahi hurmetini ifade eder.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Trusts are not limited to property; they include religious obligations, God's and people's rights, agencies, guardianships, and public offices.
rows.anchor: “Emanet” yalnız mala münhasır değildir. Bütün tekâlîf-i şer‘iye, hukūkullah ve hukūk-ı ibâd, vekâletler, velâyetler, me’mûriyetler dahi emanetler cümlesindendir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Covenants include contracts and commitments made to God, the Prophet, and other people.
rows.anchor: gerek Allah’a ve Peygamber’e ve gerek nâsa karşı olan mukāvelât ve taahhüdâta şâmildir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The later generation is not identified; because Aad and Thamud often follow Noah's people in Qur'anic accounts, Elmalılı considers Aad and Hud likely here.
rows.anchor: zikrolunduğuna[^2] nazaran bu karndan murad Âd, resûlün de Hûd olması melhuzdur.

rows.speaker: others
rows.claim: An alternative identification is Thamud and their prophet Salih.
rows.anchor: Semûd ve Sâlih de denilmiştir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Unlike the account of Noah's people, this one highlights denial of the Hereafter and arrogant indulgence in worldly luxury, traits Elmalılı also sees in contemporary unbelievers.
rows.anchor: bunların hakkında ise küfürleriyle beraber âhiret likāsını tekzib ve hayât-ı dünyada nimet ile şımarıklık hasletleri de bilhassa zikredilmiştir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The chiefs deny human prophethood by reducing the prophet to an ordinary person who eats and drinks as they do.
rows.anchor: beşerî risaleti kabul etmemekle beraber peygamberi alelâde bir beşer seviyesinde göstermek için beşeriyeti yiyip içtiği şeylerle mukayese ediyor

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı calls the chiefs' unconditional rejection of human obedience a kharijite and anarchist doctrine; human societies need a leader, including republics.
rows.anchor: beşerin beşere itaatini bilâ kayd ü şart inkâr eden bu söz, hâricîlik ve anarşistlik davasıdır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He says revolutionary unbelievers invoke freedom to advance their own interests, dismantling obedience and destroying the social order for pleasure.
rows.anchor: kendi garaz ve menfaatlerini elde etmek için hürriyet davası altında itaat umdelerini yıkarak milletlerin nizâm-ı ictimâ‘îlerini tahrib etmekten zevk alırlar.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The luxurious deniers of the Hereafter try to undermine obedience to the Prophet by depicting legitimate human obedience as slavery and loss, threatening the community's survival.
rows.anchor: Allah’ın emriyle peygambere itaat hissini kırmak için beşerin beşere meşrû olan itaat esasını bir esaret ve hüsran meâlinde göstererek kökünden baltalamaya çalışıyorlardı.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people dismiss bodily resurrection from dust and bones as impossibly remote, claim worldly life is all there is, and say one generation dies as another is born, so they should enjoy this low life.
rows.anchor: kimimiz bir taraftan ölür, kimimiz de yeni doğar hayata geliriz, böyle gider

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The chiefs accuse the prophet of fabricating a lie against God and refuse to believe him; Elmalılı says modern unbelievers repeat the oldest disbelievers' arguments.
rows.anchor: zamanımız kâfirlerinin ve bâhusus münevverlik taslayan asrî zındıkların dine karşı söyledikleri sözler de en eski kâfirlerin bu sözlerine irticâ‘dan başka bir şey değildir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hud prays for God's aid in response to his people's denial.
rows.anchor: “Rabbim! Beni tekziblerine mukabil bana nusret ver” dedi.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God tells Hud that the deniers will soon become regretful.
rows.anchor: “Birazdan” dedi, “mutlak nâdim olacaklar”

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A cry seizes the people justly; God sweeps them away like flood scum and declares the wicked far removed.
rows.anchor: Biz onları bir gusâ hâline getiriverdik yani bir sel köpüğü gibi savuruverdik {فَبُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ} artık defolsun öyle zâlimler.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The houses are mosques; their elevation means both unusually lofty buildings and their being held in honor and reverence.
rows.anchor: yani binâlarının diğer evlerden ziyade irtifâ‘ı

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The preceding parable's niche, lamp, glass, blessed tree, fruit, oil, light upon light, and guidance are manifested in these mosques.
rows.anchor: O mişkât, o misbah, o zücâce, o mübarek ağaç, o meyve, o yağ, o îkād, o nûr üstüne nûr, o hidâyet bunların içinde temessül eyler.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Morning and evening glorification means declaring and sanctifying God's name in the mosques.
rows.anchor: Allah’ın ismini tenzih ve takdis eyler

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For these men, neither commerce nor buying and selling distracts them from remembering God, prayer, or giving zakat.
rows.anchor: ne bir ticaret, ne de bir bey‘-ne alım ne satım- Allah’ı zikirden ve namaz kılmaktan ve zekât vermekten onları alıkoymaz

words: يَخَافُونَ يَوْمًۭا تَتَقَلَّبُ فِيهِ ٱلْقُلُوبُ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They fear the Day on which hearts and eyes will turn about.
rows.anchor: kalblerin ve gözlerin döneceği günden korkarlar

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God rewards them with the best of their deeds and adds further gifts from His grace.
rows.anchor: Allah, kendilerini amellerinin daha güzeliyle mükâfatlandırsın

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Beyond the promised reward according to deeds, from tenfold to seven hundredfold in quality and quantity, God grants extra blessings whose measure and nature are unspecified and beyond imagination.
rows.anchor: Bire on ilâ yedi yüz gibi husûsiyet ve

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God provides without account to whomever He wills; this is the state of believers whom He guides to His light.
rows.anchor: İşte Allah’ın nûruna hidâyet ettiği mü’minlerin hâli böyle.
